agenda_text:
FINANCE AUTHORITY OF LONG BEACH AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 29, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 2:00 PM

Thomas B. Modica, Chairperson  Dawn McIntosh, Authority Counsel
Kevin Riper, Vice Chair & Executive Director  Monique De La Garza, Authority Secretary
Hank Kim, Treasurer/Auditor

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  clarissa.cresswell@longbeach.gov

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-55690  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Finance Authority of Long
  Beach meeting of Thursday, March 30, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  26-55691  Recommendation to adopt resolution to establish regular meeting dates on August
  5, 2026 and September 23, 2026 for the Finance Authority of Long Beach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Finance Authority of Long Beach on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
 limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
 prior to the meeting.

 NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
 https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
 Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Clarissa Cresswell at
 clarissa.cresswell@longbeach.gov.
